provider.title: Model Providers
provider.subtitle: Configure each upstream once: set the key, then add models in bulk or one by one
provider.emptyText: No providers yet. Click "Add Provider" to start from a common preset

onboarding.title: Connect your first model in three steps
onboarding.subtitle: About one minute in total - once connected you can issue keys to your apps
onboarding.footTip: The catalog already includes DeepSeek, GLM, OpenAI and other common vendors - URL and path are filled in for you
onboarding.step1Desc: Choose one from the preset catalog, or enter a custom upstream URL
onboarding.step2Desc: The sk-xxx string from the vendor console - one key per vendor is enough
onboarding.step3Desc: Create a key for your apps, with daily quota and expiry

provider.nextStepSetKey: Next: set the upstream API key
provider.nextStepAddModel: Next: add models under this provider
provider.nextStepCreateKey: Next: create a gateway key and start calling
provider.deleteConfirm: Delete provider "{name}"? Its models will be kept and unlinked (calls keep working); you can re-add the provider and link again later.
provider.rotateKeySuccess: Key rotated and synced to all models of this provider
provider.presetCustomDesc: Not in the list? Enter a custom address and key
provider.formAdapterAuto: Leave empty to use the global adapter
provider.formApiKeyPlaceholder: e.g. sk-xxx, only once per provider
provider.formApiKeyTip: The key is only used when the gateway forwards requests upstream. All models share it - no need to re-enter it per model.
provider.formApiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the current key
provider.formModelsPathTip: Which path under {baseUrl} to call when discovering models; leave empty to derive from the request path (e.g. /v1/models)
provider.formRequired: Please fill in provider name, upstream URL and API key
provider.discoverTip: Fetch the available model list from upstream automatically (requires correct URL and key)
provider.discoverEmpty: Upstream returned no models. Use "Add one" below instead
provider.discoveredList: Upstream models (check to add in bulk)
provider.singleModelIdPlaceholder: e.g. deepseek-chat, must match the upstream model name
provider.singleDisplayNamePlaceholder: e.g. My Chat, for list display only
provider.addedModelsEmpty: No models under this provider yet. Discover or add one above
provider.serviceTypeDefaultTip: Models are added as instances of this model category (adjustable in the advanced instance list)
provider.rotateKeyTip: The new key is synced to all models of this provider automatically - no need to edit them one by one
